messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The MPOO deregisters at the GO. The GO verifies the deregistration. The GO rejects the deregistration of the MPOO or the GO preliminarily confirms the deregistration of the MPOO. The GO prepares the readmission of the measuring point. Optionally, the GO may oblige the MPOO to continue the operations. If the GO binds the MPOO to continue the operation, the MPOO confirmes the continuation to the MPOO. The GO performs the equipment acquisition and / or equipment changes. The GO assigns the GO as MPO. The GO informs the MPOO about the end of the assignment of the MPOO and the beginning of the assignment of the GO. The GO informs the MSPO about the assignment of the GO. The GO informs the SP about the assignment of the GO.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="MPOO_Deregistration_Process" name="MPOO Deregistration Process" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="MPOO deregisters at the GO">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Verify" name="GO verifies the deregistration">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ExclusiveGateway_Out</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="ExclusiveGateway_Decision" name="Decision on Deregistration">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ExclusiveGateway_Out</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reject</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Confirm</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Reject" name="Deregistration Rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Reject</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareReadmission" name="GO prepares the readmission of the measuring point">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Confirm</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OptionalCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="ExclusiveGateway_Optional" name="Oblige MPOO to continue?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OptionalCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoObligation</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Obligation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MPOOConfirm" name="MPOO confirms the continuation to the GO">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Obligation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AfterConfirm</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Equipment" name="GO performs equipment acquisition and/or equipment changes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoObligation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AfterConfirm</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AssignGO</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignGO" name="GO assigns the GO as MPO">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AssignGO</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InformMPOO</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InformMPOO" name="GO informs the MPOO about the end of the assignment of the MPOO and the beginning of the assignment of the GO">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InformMPOO</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ParallelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="ParallelGateway_Split" name="Inform Stakeholders">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ParallelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InformMSPO</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InformSP</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InformMSPO" name="GO informs the MSPO about the assignment of the GO">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InformMSPO</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ParallelJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InformSP" name="GO informs the SP about the assignment of the GO">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InformSP</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ParallelJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="ParallelGateway_Join" name="End Informing">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ParallelJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Success" name="Process Completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_Verify" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExclusiveGateway_Out" sourceRef="Task_Verify" targetRef="ExclusiveGateway_Decision" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reject" name="Reject" sourceRef="ExclusiveGateway_Decision" targetRef="EndEvent_Reject" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirm" name="Preliminarily Confirm" sourceRef="ExclusiveGateway_Decision" targetRef="Task_PrepareReadmission" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OptionalCheck" sourceRef="Task_PrepareReadmission" targetRef="ExclusiveGateway_Optional" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoObligation" name="No Obligation" sourceRef="ExclusiveGateway_Optional" targetRef="Task_Equipment" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Obligation" name="Oblige to Continue" sourceRef="ExclusiveGateway_Optional" targetRef="Task_MPOOConfirm" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AfterConfirm" sourceRef="Task_MPOOConfirm" targetRef="Task_Equipment" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssignGO" sourceRef="Task_Equipment" targetRef="Task_AssignGO" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InformMPOO" sourceRef="Task_AssignGO" targetRef="Task_InformMPOO" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelSplit" sourceRef="Task_InformMPOO" targetRef="ParallelGateway_Split" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InformMSPO" sourceRef="ParallelGateway_Split" targetRef="Task_InformMSPO" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InformSP" sourceRef="ParallelGateway_Split" targetRef="Task_InformSP" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelJoin" sourceRef="Task_InformMSPO" targetRef="ParallelGateway_Join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelJoin_SP" sourceRef="Task_InformSP" targetRef="ParallelGateway_Join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_End" sourceRef="ParallelGateway_Join" targetRef="EndEvent_Success" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
